notes.title: New Game Release: Red Spider Remastered Is Out!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26957866/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"][/img]To all our series fans,[/p][p]Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.[/p][p]The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider![/p][p]You can find the store page here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582550/Red_Spider/" style="button"]Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered[/url][/p]

notes.title: Red Spider Chronicle Update
notes.notes: The contents of  Red Spider Anecdote:The Longest were added to Red Spider Chronicle, bringing the total number of pages to 364.

notes.title: “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite” will be released on December 24!
notes.notes:
The latest in the “Red Spider”series of Hong Kong noir novel games, “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite”is scheduled for release in December 24.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26957866/c13533237d16c668093913acbb6fc36b4069dce7.jpg[/img]
The hard-boiled story takes place in Thailand in 2009.
It is a full-voice work with all-new graphics.
Music is by Yasunori Shiono and Yukio Nakajima.
Please add it to your wish list.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355700/_/]Steam Store[/url]

Character introductions and a sample corner of the original soundtrack are available on the official website.
[url=https://www.rpgdl.org/rscane/]Official Website[/url]
